text:
maria: Heads-up — just escalated a customer ticket. After SDK regen this morning some users started hitting 401s and huge retry loops that spiked billing.
liam: Ugh, which SDK and which change?
support-josh: Customer on Py SDK 1.14.0 -> 1.15.0. Root cause looks like auth header rename from `X-API-Key` -> `Authorization` in the generated client. Old infra still sends X-API-Key; new server expects Authorization and 401 triggers client retry logic. Billing spike from repeated token exchange + failed calls.
maria: We saw a deploy-bot alert earlier: `sre-bot: alert /v1/generate error_rate 4.3% -> 401` and support escalated around 09:12.
liam: CI for regen jobs passed locally but the integration test that covers header compatibility was skipped (flaky). I can reproduce with a minimal script: 
```
# repro.py
import redwood
c = redwood.Client(api_key="sk-...", use_legacy_header=True)
resp = c.generate("hi")
print(resp)
```
returns 401 when client sends `Authorization` header missing.
anika: We should do a short-term patch: add a compatibility shim in the Py client that maps `X-API-Key` -> `Authorization` if present, and add an environment toggle so we can roll back. Also add an environment toggle so we can roll back. Also add a unit test to CI that asserts both headers accepted.
maria: Customer needs an ETA. Can we get a hotfix and a canary release today?
liam: I can cut a patch branch now. Proposed steps: 1) add shim + feature-flag, 2) run regen pipeline, 3) push canary to dedicated infra region, 4) monitor error_rate.
support-josh: Also recommend sending the customer a temporary mitigation (they can set `REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_AUTH=1`) and we'll credit the excess usage. Need a PR and changelog entry for billing ops.
anika: I'll draft the PR and changelog. For longer term: add a regen check that compares OpenAPI header names against previous release and fails CI if a breaking rename is detected unless explicitly opted in.
liam: Agreed. I found the offending commit: `openapi/specs/clients.yaml` update 9f3b2c -> renamed `X-API-Key` to `Authorization`. I'll add a bisect script: `scripts/regen-bisect --since 9f3b2c --check-headers`.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed to eu-west-1 with shim enabled. Monitor: /v1/generate 5m error_rate -> 0.12% :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team. After canary stabilizes, let's schedule a retro to tighten regen CI and add a checklist for header/backcompat. Also coordinate with billing to issue credit.
liam: I'll open the PR now: draft link https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/451 (will update).
support-josh: I'll queue the customer note and start the credit request.
anika: One more: add a short e2e that runs against the last two published server versions to catch these mismatches in future.
maria: Perfect. Closing loop when PR merged and credit processed.
